messages:
maria: deploybot flagged preflight eval delta for summarizer v2.2.3; canary is in change window but prompt-suite regression ~4.2% on F1. holding release for now, need decision: pin > rollback > hotfix?

deploybot: AUTOMATED: preflight-eval 12345 for release v2.2.3 -> metric: summarizer.prompt_suite.F1_delta = -4.2% (p<0.01). samples: 240/240. See: https://ci.redwood/evals/12345

priya: looked at examples, seems concentrated on multi-paragraph CTX cases — hallucination rate up on Q/A prompts. sample excerpts in the eval link. not all noisy but consistent.

jonathan: thanks priya. is this specific to the quant profile we enabled in canary (int8-fast)?

priya: preliminary yes — model variant q-int8-fast shows higher token-level divergence vs baseline. need an eng-ml confirmation.

samir: tagging in eng-platform /cc @zach. quick triage: two pragmatic options: 1) pin v2.2.2 for EU/NA and continue hotfix branch for v2.2.3; 2) soft-rollback full canary (stop v2.2.3) and run quant-sanity hotpatch; 3) accept with QA signoff (not ideal).

zach: product preference is minimize customer impact. pinning EU only is ok short-term if rollback risks data churn. we need release notes update + customer comms if we pin.

maria: can we get a quick bisect of quant profiles? samir any ETA?

samir: I can run a targeted rerun comparing q-int8-fast vs q-int8-safe across the failing prompt set; ETA ~40m. will post results here.

deploybot: ACTIONABLE: to pin run `/deploybot pin release v2.2.2 --scope=region:eu,na --until=2026-04-02T12:00:00Z`

jonathan: if bisect shows q-int8-safe matches baseline then hotfix (build + rollout) is shorter than rollback. but we need to measure inference perf tradeoff.

priya: QA estimate: extra regression sweep + signoff ~2.5 hours if hotfix branch validated quickly.

maria: tentative plan: wait for samir results, if q-int8-safe within 0.5% of baseline -> hotfix and roll forward. else pin regionally and schedule rollback window tomorrow.

samir: bisect started. job 6789 queued -> link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/6789. will update when done.

qa-bot: NOTE: running additional prompt-suite sweep (subset) in parallel; will post aggregated diffs when complete.

zach: i'll draft a short release-note blurb and customer advisory stub in case we pin (keeps comms ready).

maria: thanks everyone. please react here when you see the bisect result. :thumbsup:
